geoSplitLines._comment: A geoSplit lets two regions SHARE a zip list and be told apart by the stop's actual coordinates. Needed because highway boundaries cut through zips — 98501, 98502, 98503 and 98513 each straddle the I-5/US-101 line, so a zip rule would misplace about a third of the Olympia work. Membership is resolved per address by geo-side.mjs; the answer is cached in geo-side-cache.json, refreshed with `node thurston-split.mjs --write-cache`. An address with no cached side falls back to `fallbackSide` for its zip and is logged, so a brand-new customer never blocks a plan.

optimoRouteDrivers._comment: Driver records CONFIRMED to exist in OptimoRoute. Serials on this account are the full name. get_drivers returns AUTH_KEY_UNKNOWN and get_routes only reveals drivers that already have stops, so a driver with no routes is otherwise invisible — this list is what stops the sync pre-flight false-flagging them. THIS LIST IS HAND-MAINTAINED AND CAN GO STALE: it wrongly reported Robert Norton missing on 2026-08-06 minutes after Spencer created him. If the pre-flight flags someone you believe exists, probe live before believing the list (assign one order to that serial and read the response — ERR_DRV_NOT_EXISTS is definitive). create_driver is not available on this API key, so new drivers are added in the OptimoRoute UI.

dayOverrides._comment: Pin one job to a specific weekday, overriding its region rhythm. For properties that sit inside one region's zip but belong on another region's run. Beats the rhythm; does NOT change the technician (use jobOverrides for that).

jobOverrides._comment: Job-level TECH pins. Beats the region owner (assign-by-territory.mjs:171). Job-level DAY pins go in dayOverrides instead. PRIOR STATE, kept for history: EMPTY BY DESIGN as of 2026-08-07. Spencer: 'nothing should be pinned to me.' The former #8056 Madera West Condos -> Spencer Hill pin is removed — it was the last thing keeping him in the field, and it was also the one stop OptimoRoute could never schedule, because his driver record has no working days. Job-level TECH pins go here; job-level DAY pins go in dayOverrides.
jobOverrides._snoqualmie: Spencer 2026-09-17, asked directly before the week-of-09-21 chain run: Snoqualmie Valley (98014/98024/98045/98065/98019) is SPLIT in practice, not Alias-only as v9 region "Snoqualmie Valley / Duvall" states — measured 2026-09-18..10-31, Tavis holds 23 jobs there and Alias 39. Spencer chose KEEP TAVIS on the ones he already has, so these 23 are pinned by JOB (continuity: the customer keeps their tech) rather than by moving the region owner, which would hand Alias's 39 to Tavis as well. Without these pins assign-by-territory hands all 23 back to Alias on every run — it did so silently before today. Re-measure if the split shifts; delete a pin once that job ends.

capacity.source: zip-census-2026-07-27_2026-08-07.json (1,074 visits / 2 weeks) — re-dealt five ways by route-engine/scripts/five-way-highway.mjs
capacity.note: Five techs, 153.7 h/wk, 19.2 of 25 tech-days — 76% utilised before commute, against 97% at four. That slack is deliberate: Spencer staffs NEAR PEAK so busy season still fits inside 8h days. Compare load by hoursPerWeek, never visit count. Caveat: these hours assume one pace for every tech, and measured pace varies 23% (Cory 17.3 min/stop to Alias 21.3), so Alias's 34.1 h/wk is effectively heavier than it reads and Cory's 30.2 lighter. Per-driver service times are still NOT set in OptimoRoute — Robert and Tavis are too new.

rhythmChanges._comment: New route-day for each region block, effective 2026-08-17. NOT written into regions[].rhythm because rhythm has no date mechanism and consumers (make-service-day-sheet, build-address-day-lookup) read it for TODAY. Re-dealing 22 blocks into 5 territories breaks v8's one-block-per-weekday tiling, so blocks must move days or a tech gets a dead day plus two 9h days. Spencer chose 2026-08-12 to absorb this in one move. Tuned by day-tile.mjs at churn-weight=2: the cheapest point with zero dead route-days and nothing past 8.8h. A block listed on two days has its zips split across both.

_d3: crossesOwners and ownerFrom20260817 REMOVED 2026-08-21 (route-engine spec v2, defect D3 — corrected diagnosis). Both were stored copies of something derivable, and both had drifted: ownerFrom20260817 claimed Tavis Alexander owned "North of SR-516" and "Issaquah South" while the handovers array — the only thing the code reads — gives both to Robert Norton from 2026-08-17. Nothing read either field. Ownership is a function of the DATE because handovers move it, so a stored boolean cannot be right in general: sr-516 crosses owners before 2026-08-17 (Cory north / Robert south) and does not from 2026-08-17 (Robert both sides). Derive with crossesOwners(T, line, date) in geo-side.mjs. NOTE spec v2 D3 asserted sr-516 was mismarked and should be flipped to true — that was read off the stale field and is WRONG from 08-17 onward; flipping it would be a regression.
